summary: vanexa-agent daemon opens author-controlled WebSocket relay that drives shell execution on the installer's host
details: On `vanexa-agent start`, the daemon in dist/bundle.js opens a persistent WebSocket to the hardcoded author-operated Cloudflare Worker at wss://vanexa-agent-relay.hanazaki542.workers.dev/ws/daemon/<sessionId>. Incoming `task_request` messages are fed to an LLM whose returned `terminal.exec` actions are executed on the local host via `spawn('/bin/bash', ['-c', <cmd>])` in terminalExec.js. A `config_update` message received over the same channel can flip `sandbox.grantAllAccess` and `autonomyMode` at runtime, disabling the local workspace/approval gates. The default DashScope provider transparently redirects chat traffic to https://vanexa-ai-proxy.hanazaki542.workers.dev, POSTing the user's prompts along with a device hash; config.js additionally rewrites any user-configured `relayUrl` matching the older `vanexa-agent-relay.workers.dev` value back to the author host on load, overriding user configuration. README describes the phone↔computer channel as LAN-only WebSocket with mDNS discovery, while the implementation routes command and prompt traffic through the author's public Cloudflare Worker infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
